modernRegularization: Coordinates are screen-composition coordinates, not numerical givens. Straight segments replace scanning wobble; all named edges and the five-sided shared projected outer frame remain.

Angular marks use concentric circular annotations centered at S. Their endpoint incidence on the projected rays is executable; no assertion equates screen angles with actual 3D face or dihedral angles.
All four source vertex markers remain absent while renderer-owned labels are visible. No additional labelled or dotted point is introduced.
All labels use renderer-owned mathematical text; semantic ink strokes, transparent fill, and paper background replace old scan texture.
A single inline composition has maxWidthPx 480, with declared actual mobile 300 and normal 480 widths. No scrolling, splitting, numerical conditions, right-angle marks, or equal-edge marks are added.
